$Comment: The sample script room for a skill lock with one branch per kind of server: a small hall whose north nook is
walled off by a lock. Where a mod that keeps skill levels runs, Mining 20 opens it and anyone short of it is told
so; where that mod is not installed, any pickaxe opens it and anyone without one is told to bring one. A
generated run places only the lock volume whose Where holds on its server, so each server speaks only its own
line. Opening it counts Secret_Found and raises the cache in the nook.
Example:Skills stands for that mod's Group:Name, and the server.sample.* lang keys and the Zc_Sample_Cache table
are placeholders: nothing ships them, since the room is never built; a real room names its own in their places.
Cells are relative to the prefab anchor, the south doorway's floor cell; North is -Z.
Label: Sample two-way lock
